text: Student Summer Training One of ITIDA's Human Capital Development Programs (HCDP) "Student Summer Training," one of ITIDA's Human Capital Development Programs (HCDP), began in 2014. It offers hands-on training on the up-to-the-minute technology trends for the students. The program provides free practical training on the latest technology trends for the students. It aims to build students' capacities and prepare them to work in the IT market after graduation.

In this Summer Internship program, ITIDA collaborates with telecom and technology companies through Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. It also works with the National Telecommunication Institute (NTI) for its wide technical training experience and diverse partnerships with multiple global tech companies.
